A '''battle''' took place shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalaan/Legends|Kalaan]].

==Build-up==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had established a base on the world, taking up refuge among the [[Kalaanite]]s in [[Kalaan City]]. Learning of [[Kalaan/Legends|Kalaan's]] connection to the Rebellion, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] commanders planned to subjugate the planet and root out any Rebel presence. A task force of five [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] arrived in orbit above the planet deployed a cloud of dropships, mostly [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing crafts]] and [[Theta-class barge/Legends|''Theta''-class AT-AT barges]]. Emerging from the drop ships was a combined force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], [[All Terrain Anti Aircraft/Legends|AT-AA]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], with [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] providing combat support.

==The battle==
[[File:Kalaan_battle2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T1-B hovertank|hovertanks]] engage [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].]]
The columns of Imperial armor closed on the city. Some distance out, they were met by skirmish line of [[T1-B hovertank]]s. The hovertanks proved no match for the AT-STs and AT-ATs until the heavier [[T3-B heavy attack tank]]s rolled over a ridge to support them. Combined with air support from [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]], the Rebels were able to put a dent in the Imperial columns.

Despite the temporary halting of the Imperial force, the Rebels' efforts were to no avail, and the city fell to the Empire. Squadrons of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] demolished the city, leaving mostly rubble.

In the aftermath of the battle, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squads combed the ruins of the city. On one such patrol, a unit of [[Cattena Squadron]] had its sergeant killed, at which point [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Brenn Tantor]] took command. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Beri Tulon]], scouting the battlefield for talented commanders to put to use in the [[Battlefield Holographic Control Interface|BHCI]] program, took notice of Tantor's performance.

==Aftermath==
Tulon met Tantor's squad in time to see Brenn tending to his brother [[Dellis Tantor|Dellis]], who had been shot by a [[Kalaanite]]. Tulon promoted Brenn to [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and pulled him for the project. Dellis came along to receive medical attention.

As a result of the battle, the Empire took control of the planet, built a [[Kalaan prison|prison]], and stripped much of it of vegetation, feeding the resentments of the [[Kalaanite resistance]].
